## Walmart Pivots to Advertising Revenue as Core Retail Sales Growth Slows

WMT's retail media build is a bellwether for consumer demand health and for the broader shift of ad dollars to commerce media platforms; decelerating core retail sales at WMT is also a macro data point on consumer spending that intersects with growth-factor positioning across the portfolio.

- Walmart is leaning into advertising as a growth driver as retail sales momentum decelerates
- The pivot signals a shift toward higher-margin ad revenue in WMT's revenue mix
- Consumer demand softening is implied as the structural driver behind slowing retail sales
- Two outlets converge on the same framing, reinforcing the signal
